//: Time-boxed exceptions to the high-severity production dependency gate. Policy: docs/quality/dependency-audit-policy.md. Every field is mandatory; an expired OR no-longer-matching entry fails CI. Critical severities cannot be excepted.

exceptions.rationale: CSRF bypass in React Router's RSC (React Server Components) request handler: an action can execute before the 400 response is returned. packages/web is a client-rendered Vite SPA — it has no RSC entrypoint, no server request handler, and no react-router/rsc import — so the vulnerable code path is not reachable in this build. The advisory range (7.12.0 - 8.2.0) covers the pinned 7.18.1, and the fix landed in 8.3.0, i.e. remediation is a React Router v7 -> v8 major migration rather than a patch bump.
exceptions.mitigation: No RSC usage to disable. Tracked separately as a React Router v8 migration; the SPA's mutating requests go through the API's own auth + CORS layers (verifyClerkSession, CORS_ORIGIN pinned in production), which are unaffected by this advisory.
